_readme: frz-chatgpt-toolset (owner, 2026-09-26): the /mcp/chatgpt tools/list as submitted to the OpenAI app directory (DC Hub 1.0.0, submitted 2026-09-25 ~18:06 PT, in review). Names, count, titles, descriptions, annotations and input schemas are frozen while the app is in review: adding, removing or renaming a tool, or changing any of these, forces a new review. Captured from live https://dchub.cloud/mcp/chatgpt tools/list. To change it deliberately after the review closes, regenerate this file in the same PR and say so.

tools.name: ai_capacity_index
tools.title: AI Capacity Index
tools.description: Rank data-center markets by where large AI training capacity could land in the next 30, 60 or 90 days, with facility and operator counts.

limit.description: Number of top markets to return (default 20)

tools.name: analyze_parcel
tools.title: Analyze Parcel
tools.description: Analyze a parcel boundary (GeoJSON, or lat/lon in a hosted county) for acreage, shape and nearby infrastructure.

geometry.description: GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon parcel boundary, e.g. {"type":"Polygon","coordinates":[[[lng,lat],[lng,lat],...]]} — a MultiPolygon carries discontinuous parcels as one envelope. Omit to look up the hosted parcel containing lat/lon instead

lat.description: Latitude of a point ON the parcel — used with lon when geometry is omitted to look up the containing parcel from the hosted county/state GIS layer

lon.description: Longitude of a point ON the parcel (used with lat when geometry is omitted)

latitude.description: Alias for lat — either name works

lng.description: Alias for lon — either name works

longitude.description: Alias for lon — either name works

capacity_mw.description: Optional target load in MW to pass through into the site_evaluation_handoff

tools.name: cluster_sites_by_latency
tools.title: Cluster Sites By Latency
tools.description: Group 2-8 sites into low-latency clusters using physics-bound round-trip time floors between each pair.

sites.description: "39.04,-77.48:ashburn;39.29,-76.61:baltimore". cand_… tokens are also accepted here and resolve to frozen mint coordinates. Optional if candidate_ids is given

candidate_ids.description: Array (or comma-separated string) of candidate_id values from get_refined_queue — each resolves to its FROZEN mint coordinates (zero transcription drift); expired/unknown are dropped and declared in candidate_contract. Use instead of, or alongside, sites

max_latency_us.description: Round-trip latency budget in microseconds (default 1000 µs = 1 ms; sync replication is typically 1000-2000 µs)

min_confidence.description: Minimum evidence tier a pair must meet to count as viable: "published" | "tracked" | "inferred" (default inferred = include all)

tools.name: compare_isos
tools.title: Compare ISO Regions
tools.description: Compare 2-4 US ISO grids side by side (comma-separated, e.g. "PJM,ERCOT"): fuel mix, demand, renewable and gas share, queue depth and time to power.

isos.description: Comma-separated list of 2-4 US ISO/RTO grid regions to compare, e.g. "PJM,ERCOT,CAISO" (valid: ERCOT, PJM, MISO, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, ISONE)

tools.name: deal_autopsy
tools.title: Deal Autopsy
tools.description: List recent data-center deals with the DCPI verdict and time to power of each deal's market.

limit.description: Number of recent deals to return (default ~15)

comparables.description: Comparables detail: "none" (default — count only, cheapest), "summary" (top-2 grounding signals), or "full" (the complete cited set). Escalate only for deals you're drilling into.

tools.name: discover_tools
tools.title: Discover Tools
tools.description: List DC Hub tools grouped by family (facility, market, grid and power, gas, site, fiber, deals and news), optionally filtered by a query.

query.description: Optional keyword to filter families/tools, e.g. "site selection", "grid queue", "fiber", "deals", "market"

tools.name: execute_plan
tools.title: Execute Plan
tools.description: Answer a multi-part data-center infrastructure question in one call. Pass the question as intent; DC Hub plans the lookups (markets, grid, fiber, water, incentives), runs them, and returns each step's result with a replay of how the answer was built.

intent.description: The user's infrastructure question, passed through UNCHANGED. Examples: "rank markets for a 200 MW AI campus" · "evaluate 100 MW power headroom for a GPU training cluster in PJM" · "compare Dallas vs Phoenix for a hyperscale campus" · "find 100 MW of buildable capacity near Ashburn" · "where do fiber density and grid headroom overlap in Atlanta"

context.description: Optional structured hints AND step-arg overrides: {lat, lon, iso, market, capacity_mw, candidate_id, state, since} — user-supplied values beat minted ones. The typed top-level params below are merged into this and WIN on conflict.

market.description: Metro slug or name to pin the analysis to, e.g. "ashburn". Beats any market the planner would mint.

iso.description: ISO/RTO code to pin geography, e.g. "PJM", "ERCOT".

max_fanout.description: Max per-finalist fan-out calls for one step, 1-3 (default 2)

cohort.description: Optional experiment tag for adoption/retention measurement, e.g. "cohort.front_door". Has NO effect on routing, planning, geography or results — it is recorded only. Put your user's question in `intent` and the tag HERE; never inside the intent string, which would break classification. Max 64 chars, [a-z0-9._-]; a malformed tag is ignored, never an error.

tools.name: fetch
tools.title: Fetch
tools.description: Fetch one DC Hub facility record by an id returned from search. Returns {id, title, text, url, metadata} with name, operator, location, status and market.

id.description: A facility id/slug from a prior `search` result, e.g. equinix-dc1-ashburn

tools.name: find_alternatives
tools.title: Find Alternative Facilities
tools.description: Find facilities similar to a given facility nearby, with similarity scores and key differences.

facility_id.description: The seed facility id/slug (required) to find alternatives to, from a prior search result — there is no `name` param; an undeclared key is silently stripped

radius_km.description: Search radius in km for candidate alternatives around the seed facility

match_on.description: Optional similarity dimension to weight, e.g. capacity, operator, fiber, market

exclude_operator.description: If true, exclude facilities from the same operator as the seed

limit.description: Max results to return (1-500; default varies by tool)

tools.name: find_sites
tools.title: Find Sites
tools.description: Find candidate data-center sites in a state or around a point, filtered by substation voltage and distance to gas and fiber.

state.description: 2-letter US state to search, e.g. OH — required unless you pass lat + lon

lat.description: Latitude of a search centre, e.g. 39.04 — use with lon (+ radius_km) instead of state

lon.description: Longitude of a search centre, e.g. -77.48

latitude.description: Alias for lat — either name works

lng.description: Alias for lon — either name works

longitude.description: Alias for lon — either name works

radius_km.description: Search radius in km around lat/lon (default 80, clamped 5-400); ignored in state mode

min_voltage_kv.description: Only anchor on substations at or above this voltage in kV (default 115). 230+ for hyperscale, 500 for the largest campuses

max_gas_km.description: Drop candidates farther than this from the nearest gas pipeline. Applied ONLY if the gas layer answers — check constraint_coverage

max_fiber_km.description: Drop candidates farther than this from the nearest fiber route (CHORD approximation — see fiber_distance_basis). Applied ONLY if the fiber layer answers

exclude_moratorium.description: true = drop candidates in a state with a published data-center moratorium. STATE grain, not jurisdiction grain

cluster_km.description: Collapse anchors within this many km into one candidate area (default 8, max 100). Raise it for broader coverage, lower it for denser results

limit.description: Max results to return (1-500; default varies by tool)

tools.name: get_agent_registry
tools.title: AI Agent Registry
tools.description: List the AI platforms and agent frameworks that connect to DC Hub, with their status.

tools.name: get_backup_status
tools.title: Platform Health
tools.description: Get per-feed freshness for DC Hub's data ingest: health, record count and refresh interval for each feed.

tools.name: get_changes
tools.title: Get Changes
tools.description: List what changed in DC Hub since a timestamp: DCPI market movers, newly found facilities, new deals and news.

since.description: Return changes since this ISO-8601 timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD or full datetime) or shorthand "24h"/"7d"; default 24h

limit.description: Max results to return (1-500; default varies by tool)

tools.name: get_climate_intel
tools.title: Get Climate Intel
tools.description: Get seismic design values (USGS ASCE 7) and climate normals (NOAA) for a lat/lon, such as cooling degree-days and temperature extremes.

lat.description: Site latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90, required), e.g. 33.45

lon.description: Site longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180, required), e.g. -112.07

latitude.description: Alias for lat — either name works

lng.description: Alias for lon — either name works

longitude.description: Alias for lon — either name works

radius_km.description: Max distance (km) to snap to the nearest NOAA station (optional, default 25)

tools.name: get_dchub_recommendation
tools.title: DC Hub Recommendation
tools.description: Get a short description of DC Hub for one of four contexts (general, investment, site-selection, technical), plus the current top-ranked market.

context.description: Free-text description of the siting request — MW, geography, workload, deadline, constraints, e.g. "100MW AI training campus in Texas, short time-to-power"

tools.name: get_disaster_risk
tools.title: Get Disaster Risk
tools.description: Get natural-hazard risk for a US lat/lon from the FEMA National Risk Index: flood, wildfire, hurricane, earthquake, heat, drought, tornado and more.

lat.description: Site latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90, required), e.g. 33.45

lon.description: Site longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180, required), e.g. -112.07

latitude.description: Alias for lat — either name works

lng.description: Alias for lon — either name works

longitude.description: Alias for lon — either name works

tools.name: get_energy_prices
tools.title: Energy Prices
tools.description: Get energy prices by US state or ISO: retail electricity, wholesale and natural gas.

data_type.description: Optional price type focus, e.g. retail, wholesale, gas

state.description: US state abbreviation for state-level pricing context, e.g. TX

iso.description: ISO/RTO grid region (required for ISO pricing): ERCOT, PJM, MISO, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, ISONE

tools.name: get_facility
tools.title: Get Facility Details
tools.description: Get details for one data-center facility by id, slug or name: operator, address, coordinates, power capacity, cooling, fiber carriers, status, its market's DCPI verdict and nearby facilities.

facility_id.description: Facility id from a prior search_facilities/search result (numeric or string), e.g. equinix-dc1-ashburn

slug.description: Facility slug from a prior search result, e.g. digital-realty-iad8

id.description: Alias for facility_id — a facility id/slug from a prior search result

name.description: Facility name as a fallback lookup when no id/slug is known, e.g. "QTS Ashburn"

include_nearby.description: Include peer facilities near this one in the response (default true)

include_power.description: Include power capacity detail (total/used MW) in the response (default true)

tools.name: get_facility_risk_delta
tools.title: Get Facility Risk Delta
tools.description: Show how a facility's market DCPI health changed over a time window, with direction (improving, worsening or flat).

facility_id.description: A DC Hub facility id or canonical slug to resolve the market context

market.description: Alternatively, a market name or slug (e.g. "northern-virginia")

tools.name: get_fiber_intel
tools.title: Fiber Intelligence
tools.description: Get fiber route intelligence by carrier, route type or market: long-haul and metro routes and dark-fiber availability.

carrier.description: Fiber carrier to filter on, e.g. Zayo, Lumen, Cogent, "Crown Castle", Windstream, GTT, Uniti; omit for all carriers

market.description: Metro name or slug (e.g. "dallas", "ashburn", "northern-virginia") — returns only routes touching that metro (either endpoint within ~1.2°). Great with route_type=longhaul.

include_sources.description: Include upstream data-source/provenance metadata in the response

tools.name: get_fiber_readiness
tools.title: Get Fiber Readiness
tools.description: Assess fiber readiness for a lat/lon: distance to a carrier-served facility, number of reachable carriers, and single-carrier risk.

lat.description: Site latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90, required), e.g. 39.04

lon.description: Site longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180, required), e.g. -77.48

latitude.description: Alias for lat — either name works

lng.description: Alias for lon — either name works

longitude.description: Alias for lon — either name works

radius_km.description: Search radius in km for reachable fiber carriers (default 50, range 5-200)

tools.name: get_gas_economics
tools.title: Get Gas Economics
tools.description: Get gas-fired power inputs for a US data-center market: Henry Hub spot, regional basis and delivered industrial and electric gas tariffs, each with its source.

market.description: Market slug (metro), e.g. northern-virginia, dallas, phoenix — valid slugs come from rank_markets / get_market_dcpi_rank

heat_rate_btu_per_kwh.description: Optional custom generator heat rate in Btu/kWh for the gas-to-grid $/MWh scenario, e.g. 6800 (avg CCGT)

tools.name: get_gas_index
tools.title: Gas Index (DCGI)
tools.description: Get the Data Center Gas Index (DCGI): a per-US-state natural-gas suitability score for gas-fired or behind-the-meter power.

state.description: US state abbreviation, e.g. TX, VA, AZ. Returns the DCGI score and verdict, plus `gas_price_series` naming which EIA series priced the state. A state that cannot be priced comes back verdict UNSCORED with dcgi null and an `unscored_reason` — absence, not a low score. Withdrawn 2026-08-08, restored 2026-08-30: do NOT compare against a figure published before 2026-08-08. Use get_gas_intelligence for the per-state pipeline and operator brief

limit.description: Max results to return (1-500; default varies by tool)

tools.name: get_gas_intelligence
tools.title: Get Gas Intelligence
tools.description: Get gas-fired power context for a US state or region: gas index, Henry Hub price, pipeline operators and the grid's gas share.

region.description: US state code or name (required), e.g. "TX", "Texas", "Virginia"

state.description: Alias for region — the US state code or name

tools.name: get_global_power
tools.title: Get Global Power
tools.description: List power plants and generating units worldwide (operating and pipeline, all fuels) from the Global Energy Monitor tracker. Filter by country, fuel, status, area or size.

country.description: Country/area name to filter, e.g. Germany, India, Brazil, Japan

fuel.description: Fuel/type filter, comma-separated for a union: coal, oil/gas, nuclear, solar, wind, hydro, bioenergy, geothermal

status.description: Status substring filter, e.g. operating, construction, pre-construction, announced

pipeline.description: true = ONLY the forward pipeline (announced + pre-construction + under-construction)

limit.description: Max results to return (1-500; default varies by tool)

tools.name: get_grid_data
tools.title: Live Grid Data
tools.description: Get real-time grid data for one of the 7 US ISOs from EIA hourly data: fuel mix, demand and the 24-hour demand curve.

iso.description: ISO/RTO grid region (required): ERCOT, PJM, MISO, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, ISONE

metric.description: Optional metric focus, e.g. fuel_mix, demand, demand_curve

period.description: Optional time window for the metric, e.g. 24h

tools.name: get_grid_intelligence
tools.title: Grid Intelligence
tools.description: Get a grid brief for one US ISO: demand, fuel mix, excess-power and constraint score bands, interconnection queue and time to power.

region_id.description: Grid region (required): one of the 7 US ISOs (PJM, ERCOT, CAISO, MISO, SPP, NYISO, ISO-NE), an EIA balancing-authority code (e.g. SOCO, DUK, AZPS, TVA), or the PJM Dominion zone region_id="PJM-DOM" for live Ashburn / Northern Virginia zone load + real-time LMP (the world's #1 DC market, invisible in EIA)

iso.description: Alias for region_id — the ISO/RTO or balancing-authority code

region.description: Alias for region_id — the ISO/RTO or balancing-authority code

market.description: Market NAME or metro slug instead of a grid code, e.g. "Ashburn", "northern-virginia", "dallas". Resolved to its ISO through the published DCPI market row before the brief is built; the answer carries a resolved_from block naming what it resolved to. Not an alias for region_id — "Ashburn" is not a grid code.

tools.name: get_grid_scoreboard
tools.title: Grid Scoreboard
tools.description: Get a live scoreboard of grid operators in the US, Great Britain, Europe and parts of Asia-Pacific and Latin America: demand, fuel mix, renewable share and gas share right now.

tools.name: get_hosting_capacity
tools.title: Feeder Hosting Capacity
tools.description: Get utility-published feeder hosting capacity near a location or in a market: the MW named distribution feeders can accept, from utility GIS data.

lat.description: Latitude of the point to search around, decimal degrees. Must be paired with lon.

lon.description: Longitude of the point to search around, decimal degrees. Must be paired with lat.

latitude.description: Alias for lat — either name works

lng.description: Alias for lon — either name works

longitude.description: Alias for lon — either name works

radius_km.description: Search radius in km around lat/lon (default 25, max 150). Ignored when utility/market is passed — that mode covers the utility's entire published extent.

utility.description: Utility or market name, case-insensitive substring — e.g. "Ameren Illinois", "Con Edison", "Providence". Searches that utility's whole published territory instead of a point radius. Call with NO arguments to list every covered utility.

market.description: Alias for utility — either name works (e.g. "Northern Virginia · Richmond", "New York City · Westchester").

capacity_type.description: Restrict to one published type: "load" (what a new data-center load can DRAW — the type that answers siting), "gen" (DER/generation EXPORT headroom — NOT available load), or "bus_headroom" (transmission bus MW). Omit to get all three reported separately.

min_mw.description: Only return feeders whose published capacity is at or above this many MW.

limit.description: Max results to return (1-500; default varies by tool)

tools.name: get_infra_projects
tools.title: Get Infra Projects
tools.description: List planned, approved and under-construction gas pipeline and transmission line projects. Filter by type, state, status, capacity, voltage and in-service dates.

type.description: Which project list: gas_pipeline (EIA, US-wide), transmission (ERCOT TPIT, Texas only) or all (default)

state.description: US state abbreviation, e.g. TX or LA. Gas projects match any state they cross; transmission projects are all TX

status.description: Status, case-insensitive; comma list allowed. Gas: Announced, Pre-applied, Applied, Approved, Construction, On Hold, Completed. Transmission: Planned, Conceptual, Under Construction, Completed, Cancelled

min_capacity.description: Gas only: minimum pipeline capacity in million cubic feet per day (MMcf/d), e.g. 1000. With type=all it narrows to gas projects

min_kv.description: Transmission only: minimum voltage in kilovolts (kV), e.g. 345. With type=all it narrows to transmission projects

in_service_after.description: Only projects entering service on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY). Gas compares the in-service year; transmission the actual, else projected, in-service date

in_service_before.description: Only projects entering service on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY)

new_since.description: Only projects DC Hub first saw on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). The initial backfill is never counted as new

include_delisted.description: Also return projects the latest source release no longer lists (completed, withdrawn or dropped). Default false

limit.description: Max results to return (1-500; default varies by tool)

tools.name: get_infrastructure
tools.title: Nearby Infrastructure
tools.description: List infrastructure near a location: substations, transmission lines, gas pipelines and power plants, with distance and capacity.

lat.description: Center latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90, required), e.g. 33.45

lon.description: Center longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180, required), e.g. -112.07

latitude.description: Alias for lat — either name works

lng.description: Alias for lon — either name works

longitude.description: Alias for lon — either name works

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometers around the point, e.g. 25

layer.description: Optional single asset layer to return, e.g. substations, transmission, pipelines, power_plants

min_voltage_kv.description: Only include transmission/substations at or above this voltage in kV, e.g. 69

limit.description: Max results to return (1-500; default varies by tool)

tools.name: get_intelligence_index
tools.title: Market Intelligence Index
tools.description: Get a composite 0-100 health index for a data-center market, combining supply and demand, vacancy, absorption, fiber, power availability and pricing trend.

tools.name: get_interconnection_queue
tools.title: Interconnection Queue
tools.description: Get the interconnection queue snapshot per US ISO: queued generation capacity, and for ERCOT the large-load (data-center) queue.

iso.description: ISO/RTO grid region to drill into: ERCOT, PJM, MISO, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, ISONE; omit for the all-ISO snapshot

tools.name: get_iso_context
tools.title: Get Iso Context
tools.description: Get a token-budgeted briefing for one US ISO/RTO: live grid snapshot, DCPI verdicts across its markets, queue depth, benchmark prices and tracked markets.

iso.description: ISO/RTO grid region (required): ERCOT, PJM, MISO, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, ISONE

max_tokens.description: Token budget for the pack, 200-8000 (default 4000); sections are filled in priority order until the budget is spent

tools.name: get_market_context
tools.title: Get Market Context
tools.description: Get a token-budgeted briefing for one data-center market: DCPI verdict, power and grid facts, outlook, deals, pipeline, operators, risks and news, each section timestamped.

market.description: Market slug (required), e.g. northern-virginia, dallas, phoenix — valid slugs come from rank_markets / get_market_dcpi_rank

max_tokens.description: Token budget for the pack, 200-8000 (default 4000); sections are filled in priority order until the budget is spent

tools.name: get_market_dcpi_rank
tools.title: DCPI Market Rank
tools.description: Get the DC Hub Power Index (DCPI) read for one market: BUILD/CAUTION/AVOID verdict, score bands, time to power, data basis and a short analyst narrative.

market_slug.description: Market slug (metro), e.g. northern-virginia, dallas, phoenix — valid slugs come from rank_markets / get_market_dcpi_rank

tools.name: get_market_intel
tools.title: Market Intelligence
tools.description: Get market intelligence for one data-center market (by market slug): vacancy, capacity pricing, supply pipeline, main operators and growth.

market.description: Market slug (metro), e.g. northern-virginia, dallas, frankfurt, singapore — valid slugs come from rank_markets / get_market_dcpi_rank

metric.description: Optional single metric to focus on, e.g. vacancy, pricing, absorption, pipeline

period.description: Optional time window for the metric, e.g. ttm, 12mo, ytd

compare_to.description: Optional second market slug to compare against, e.g. dallas

tools.name: get_metro_fiber
tools.title: Get Metro Fiber
tools.description: Get the fiber profile of a US data-center metro: carriers, route miles, on-net buildings, fiber-density score, exchanges and carrier hotels.

market.description: Optional metro name or slug for a single-market deep dive (carrier-by-carrier + dark fiber), e.g. "Dallas-Fort Worth", "dallas", "Northern Virginia", "ashburn". Omit to list every tracked metro ranked by fiber density.

tools.name: get_news
tools.title: Industry News
tools.description: Get curated data-center industry news. Filter by keyword, category, source and date range.

query.description: Free-text keyword to filter news, e.g. "Stargate" or "interconnection queue"

category.description: News topic filter, e.g. deals, permits, outages, policy, AI

source.description: Restrict to one trade source, e.g. DCD, "Data Center Frontier", "Capacity Media"

limit.description: Max results to return (1-500; default varies by tool)

min_relevance.description: Minimum relevance score 0-1 to include an item, e.g. 0.5

tools.name: get_peering_intel
tools.title: Get Peering Intel
tools.description: Get internet-exchange and peering density near a lat/lon from PeeringDB, or the top peering facilities overall.

lat.description: Latitude of the site, e.g. 39.04 — with lon, returns the peering profile around it; omit both for the IXP directory

latitude.description: Alias for lat — either name works

lng.description: Alias for lon — either name works

longitude.description: Alias for lon — either name works

limit.description: Max results to return (1-500; default varies by tool)

tools.name: get_permitting_intel
tools.title: Permitting & Moratorium Intel
tools.description: List data-center permitting and moratorium records by jurisdiction: moratoriums, zoning restrictions, tax changes and utility pauses, each stage-tagged with a source.

state.description: US state filter, e.g. NY or MN (optional)

tools.name: get_pipeline
tools.title: Construction Pipeline
tools.description: List data centers that are announced, permitted or under construction. Filter by status, country, operator, minimum capacity or expected completion date.

status.description: Pipeline stage filter: announced, permitted, construction, or operational

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US, DE, SG

operator.description: Operator/provider company name, e.g. Equinix, Digital Realty, AWS

min_capacity_mw.description: Minimum project power capacity filter in megawatts (MW), e.g. 50 for hyperscale

expected_completion_before.description: Only projects with expected commissioning before this ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD), e.g. 2027-01-01

limit.description: Max results to return (1-500; default varies by tool)

tools.name: get_power_availability_timeline
tools.title: Get Power Availability Timeline
tools.description: Show year by year when power gets easier in one US state: new generation by confidence class, scheduled retirements, and interconnection-queue depth.

state.description: 2-letter US state code (required), e.g. OH, GA, TX — the timeline grain; a state can span ISOs and the response reports ISO membership as context

mw.description: Optional target MW for CONTEXT ONLY — echoed back with an explicit note; never converted into an energize-by date, which this data cannot honestly state

tools.name: get_power_pipeline
tools.title: Get Power Pipeline
tools.description: List planned and under-construction US power generators from EIA-860M, including non-ISO regions. Filter by state, balancing authority, status or minimum MW.

state.description: US state abbreviation to filter generators, e.g. VA, TX

ba.description: Balancing-authority / ISO code, e.g. PJM, ERCO, SOCO, TVA, AZPS

status.description: Generator status code: P/L/T (planned), U/V (under construction), TS (testing)

min_mw.description: Minimum nameplate capacity filter in megawatts (MW)

limit.description: Max results to return (1-500; default varies by tool)

tools.name: get_refined_queue
tools.title: Get Refined Queue
tools.description: Filter the US ISO interconnection queue server-side by size, wait time, ISO, fuel, status, fiber distance and geocoding, and return only matching projects.

min_mw.description: Minimum project capacity in MW, e.g. 1000 for 1 GW+

max_ttp_months.description: Max time-to-power in months (ISO-level avg interconnection wait; HARD cut keeping projects in ISOs at/under this — PJM ~51, CAISO ~40, ISO-NE ~34, MISO ~34, ERCOT ~33, NYISO ~31, SPP ~24; <=30 leaves only SPP)

iso.description: Restrict to one or more ISOs, comma-separated for a union: PJM, ERCOT, MISO, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, ISONE (ISO-NE). e.g. iso=ERCOT,PJM. Omit for all; combines with max_ttp_months as an intersection

baseload_only.description: Keep only firm/dispatchable fuel (nuclear, gas, steam, geothermal, hydro, coal); exclude wind/solar/storage. Firm-vs-intermittent split only — does NOT sub-divide peaker vs combined-cycle gas (no duty-cycle field in the queue). Default false

fuel_type.description: Isolate a fuel by inclusive substring match on the raw label; comma/semicolon-separated for a union, e.g. 'gas' hits GAS/Natural Gas, 'nuclear,hydro' unions both. Runs the fuel filter server-side instead of post-filtering survivors in context

status.description: Queue status filter. Default 'active' = still progressing (excludes withdrawn/cancelled/suspended/in-commercial-operation) — cross-ISO safe (SPP labels live projects 'IA FULLY EXECUTED/ON SCHEDULE' not 'active'). Pass 'all' for every status, or a literal label to substring-match

max_fiber_km.description: Keep only survivors within N km of the nearest MAPPED long-haul fiber route endpoint — coarse backbone proximity from a sparse ~260-node dataset over a county-centroid origin, NOT last-mile fiber. Implies geocoded rows only

limit.description: Max results to return (1-500; default varies by tool)

tools.name: get_renewable_energy
tools.title: Renewable Energy
tools.description: Get renewable energy data for a US state or location: renewable generation mix and resource inputs for PPA sizing.

energy_type.description: Renewable type: "solar", "wind", or "combined"; omit for all

state.description: US state abbreviation, e.g. TX, VA, AZ

lat.description: Optional latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90) to find nearest projects within 50mi

lon.description: Optional longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180) to find nearest projects within 50mi

latitude.description: Alias for lat — either name works

lng.description: Alias for lon — either name works

longitude.description: Alias for lon — either name works

tools.name: get_retirement_headroom
tools.title: Get Retirement Headroom
tools.description: Find scheduled generator retirements within a time horizon that could free grid capacity for a target MW, with the nearest substations to each.

target_mw.description: Minimum required headroom in megawatts (MW) — filters to retiring generators at/above this size.

horizon_months.description: Time horizon in months to look ahead for planned retirements, 1-120 (e.g., 12, 18, 36).

region_iso.description: Optional target region or ISO (e.g., 'MISO', 'PJM', 'ERCOT', 'SPP', 'CAISO', 'NYISO', 'ISONE'). Matches the generator's own EIA balancing-authority code — real market boundaries, not state lines. Comma-separated for a union.

fuel_filter.description: Optional filter for retiring fuel categories, substring-matched (e.g., 'Coal', 'Natural Gas', 'Petroleum').

limit.description: Max results to return (1-500; default varies by tool)

tools.name: get_subsea_cables
tools.title: Get Subsea Cables
tools.description: List subsea cable landing points near a coordinate, or the catalogue of tracked subsea cables.

lat.description: Latitude of the site, e.g. 36.85 — with lon, returns landing points near it; omit both for the cable catalogue

latitude.description: Alias for lat — either name works

lng.description: Alias for lon — either name works

longitude.description: Alias for lon — either name works

radius_km.description: Search radius in km around lat/lon for landing points (default 200)

limit.description: Max results to return (1-500; default varies by tool)

tools.name: get_tax_incentives
tools.title: Tax Incentives
tools.description: List data-center tax incentive programs for a US state: sales-tax exemptions, property-tax abatements and other programs, with thresholds.

state.description: US state abbreviation (required), e.g. VA, TX, AZ

tools.name: get_water_risk
tools.title: Water Risk
tools.description: Get water-stress risk for a US lat/lon or state, for cooling-water planning.

lat.description: Site latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90) for the most precise water-risk read, e.g. 33.45

lon.description: Site longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180), e.g. -112.07

latitude.description: Alias for lat — either name works

lng.description: Alias for lon — either name works

longitude.description: Alias for lon — either name works

state.description: US state abbreviation as an alternative to lat/lon, e.g. AZ

tools.name: grid_transition_radar
tools.title: Grid Transition Radar
tools.description: List US markets and ISOs with the strongest near-term signal of new grid headroom for large loads, with an ISO rollup.

max_months.description: Maximum acceptable time-to-power in months for the emergence signal, 1-120, e.g. 24

limit.description: Number of emerging markets to return

tools.name: hyperscaler_deals
tools.title: Hyperscaler Deal Tracker
tools.description: List recent hyperscaler and AI infrastructure deals and announcements, with amounts and MW where stated.

limit.description: Number of recent AI-capex deals to return (default 20)

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.title: M&A Transactions
tools.description: List data-center M&A and capital transactions since 2019. Filter by buyer, seller, deal value, deal type, date range or region.

buyer.description: Filter by acquiring company name, e.g. Blackstone, KKR, Digital Realty

seller.description: Filter by selling/target company name, e.g. CyrusOne

min_value_usd.description: Minimum disclosed deal value in US dollars, e.g. 1000000000 for USD 1B+

max_value_usd.description: Maximum disclosed deal value in US dollars

deal_type.description: Deal type filter, e.g. acquisition, jv, refinance, recap

region.description: Geographic region filter, e.g. us, eu, apac, americas

limit.description: Max results to return (1-500; default varies by tool)

tools.name: plan_fiber_leadin
tools.title: Plan Fiber Leadin
tools.description: Plan diverse road-following fiber lead-in routes from a site to a carrier hotel or POP, with distances, indicative build cost and shared-corridor points.

from.description: Origin site as "lat,lng" OR a street address, e.g. "250 Paringa Road, Murarrie QLD"

to.description: Destination carrier hotel/POP as "lat,lng" OR an address, e.g. "20 Wharf Street, Brisbane City QLD"

n.description: Number of diverse routes to plan, 1-6 (default 4)

fibre.description: Fibre count spec for cost estimate: "720F" or "1440F"

bore_m.description: River/rail bore length in metres to add to the route, 0-100000 (optional)

tools.name: plan_query
tools.title: Plan Query
tools.description: Show the step-by-step tool plan DC Hub would run for a question, without running it.

intent.description: Natural-language description of what you are trying to find out, e.g. "rank markets for a 200MW AI campus" or "how much power is available in ERCOT"

context.description: Optional structured hints: {lat, lon, iso, market, capacity_mw, candidate_id, state (2-letter), since} — sharpens args_hint values and routing (e.g. lat/lon boosts the site-analysis route)

tools.name: predict_market_trajectory
tools.title: Predict Market Trajectory
tools.description: Project a market's DCPI excess-power and constraint scores 1-8 quarters ahead from its daily history, with confidence bands.

market_slug.description: Market slug (metro), e.g. dallas, phoenix, northern-virginia — valid slugs come from rank_markets / get_market_dcpi_rank

horizon_quarters.description: Forecast horizon in quarters (1-8, default 4); 2 = ~6 months ahead

tools.name: rank_markets
tools.title: Rank Markets
tools.description: Rank data-center markets by a chosen criterion, optionally within a region or above a minimum capacity.

criteria.description: Ranking criterion: "cheapest_power", "most_capacity", "most_operators", "fastest_growing", "best_overall" (default), or "ai_ready" (DCPI buildability — where new AI load can land, for AI-campus siting; region us/global)

limit.description: Number of markets to return, 1-50 (default 10)

min_capacity_mw.description: Minimum existing capacity filter in megawatts (MW), e.g. 100

fields.description: Return ONLY these row fields (array or comma string) — a token diet.

projection.description: Named field preset, cheaper to send than a field list: market_summary (ranking rows), siting_summary (site/point rows), identity_only (ids + names).

tools.name: rank_sites
tools.title: Rank Sites
tools.description: Rank candidate sites you pass in (each with lat/lng and metric fields) under hard constraints and weighted objectives, with a normalized score per site.

candidates.description: Array of candidate objects. Legacy: {id?, lat?, lng?, <metric fields>} flat objects also work. Omit if using shortlist_name

constraints.description: Hard filters {field: {min?, max?}} — a candidate missing a constrained field is dropped (fail-closed). e.g. {"risk_resilience": {"min": 70}, "estimated_ttp_months": {"max": 34}}

objectives.description: Weighted objectives {field: signedWeight} — +weight maximizes, -weight minimizes. e.g. {"water_stress": -0.6, "fiber_km": -0.4}. Omit with shortlist_name to reuse the shortlist's saved objectives; required with candidates

percentile.description: true = score each objective as its PERCENTILE against the viable-site POPULATION ("better than X% of viable sites") — the strongest cross-run + cross-region comparability. Takes precedence over absolute

require_complete.description: true = DROP any candidate missing one or more of your (validated) objectives — dropped candidates are DECLARED in excluded_incomplete, never silent. Default false keeps incomplete candidates ranked on their carried objectives with missing_objectives flagged. Recommended true for autonomous take-rank-1 workflows (an incomplete candidate can otherwise top the ranking on its single best metric).

top_k.description: How many top-ranked sites to return (1-50, default 3)

tools.name: research_task
tools.title: Research Dossier (async)
tools.description: Request a cited research brief on a data-center question from DC Hub's news, deals, facilities and market analyses. Returns the brief, or a task_id to check back with.

question.description: The research question (min 12 chars) — omit when polling with task_id

task_id.description: Poll an earlier submission: the task_id returned by a previous research_task call

tools.name: score_facility
tools.title: Score Facility
tools.description: Score one existing facility 0-100 across power, fiber, water, climate risk, tax environment, talent pool and expansion room.

facility_id.description: The facility id/slug to score (required), from a prior search_facilities result

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search
tools.description: Search DC Hub for data-center facilities matching a text query. Returns a list of {id, title, url}; pass an id to fetch for the record.

query.description: Free-text query, e.g. "data centers in Northern Virginia" or "Ashburn hyperscale power"

tools.name: search_facilities
tools.title: Search Facilities
tools.description: Search data-center facilities by name, country, state, city, operator, capacity range (MW) or Uptime tier. Returns matching facilities with location, operator and capacity where known.

query.description: Free-text search over facility name/operator/location (mapped to the backend `q` param), e.g. "hyperscale Ashburn"

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US, GB, SG

state.description: US state abbreviation or region, e.g. VA, TX

city.description: City name to filter facilities, e.g. Ashburn, Dallas

operator.description: Operator/provider company name, e.g. Equinix, Digital Realty

min_capacity_mw.description: Minimum power capacity filter in megawatts (MW)

max_capacity_mw.description: Maximum power capacity filter in megawatts (MW)

limit.description: Max results to return (1-500; default varies by tool)

tools.name: search_intelligence
tools.title: Search Intelligence
tools.description: Search DC Hub news, M&A deals, facilities and market analyses by meaning, choosing corpora by name. Same retrieval as semantic_search with a different call shape.

query.description: Natural-language query (required), e.g. "grids opening up for AI load in the Southeast"

corpus.description: Optional corpus to restrict to: news | deals | facilities | market_narratives. CSV of several is allowed; default searches all.

limit.description: Max results to return, 1-15 (default 8)

tools.name: semantic_search
tools.title: Semantic Search
tools.description: Search DC Hub news, M&A deals, facilities and market analyses by meaning rather than keywords. Returns ranked records with source fields for citation.

q.description: Natural-language query (required), e.g. "grids opening up for AI load in the Southeast"

query.description: Alias for q — the same natural-language query; send exactly one of q/query

corpus.description: Optional CSV of corpora: news_articles, deals, discovered_facilities, market_narratives (default: all)

tools.name: simulate_scenario
tools.title: Market Scenario Simulator
tools.description: Re-score DC Hub power markets under what-if changes you set (power price, time to power, queue wait, reserve margin, curtailment) and show how rankings move.

avg_kwh_cents_pct.description: Power price % change, e.g. 30 for +30% or -20 for -20%

time_to_power_months_delta.description: Months added (+) or removed (-) from time-to-power, e.g. 12

queue_wait_months_delta.description: Months added/removed from interconnection queue wait

reserve_margin_pct_delta.description: Percentage POINTS added/removed from reserve margin, e.g. -5

market.description: Score ONE market by slug (optional), e.g. abilene — slugs from rank_markets

top_n.description: Markets to return, ranked by |score delta| (default 10)

tools.name: site_selection_canvas
tools.title: Site Selection Canvas
tools.description: Shortlist US markets for a capacity target, geography and deadline, ranked by DCPI verdict, excess-power headroom and time to power.

capacity_mw.description: Target power load for the build in megawatts (MW), 1-5000, e.g. 100

region.description: Geography scope: a US state code like TX, an ISO like ERCOT, or a region like us/apac. `state` and `iso` are accepted as aliases for this same filter.

state.description: US state code, e.g. OH — alias for `region`. Use either; `region` wins if both are sent.

iso.description: ISO/RTO code, e.g. ERCOT or PJM — alias for `region`. Use either; `region` wins if both are sent.

max_months.description: Maximum acceptable time-to-power in months, 1-120, e.g. 24

verdict.description: Optional DCPI verdict filter: BUILD, CAUTION, or AVOID — or ALL to see every scored market in the geography. Defaults to BUILD,CAUTION, so a geography whose markets are all AVOID returns matched:0 plus an `empty_result` block explaining that; re-run with verdict=ALL to see those rows.

limit.description: Number of shortlist markets to return

tools.name: summarize_for_citation
tools.title: Citation Block
tools.description: Build an attribution line for a DC Hub figure you are about to quote, with the licence that applies to its data layer.

subject.description: What you are citing, in the words you will show the human, e.g. "Ashburn DCPI verdict" or "ERCOT interconnection queue depth"

as_of.description: The as_of you read off the cited response (provenance.as_of). Omit it and the line says RETRIEVED instead of claiming a data date.

url.description: The profile_url or dcpi_url from the cited row. Must be a dchub.cloud URL; anything else is dropped and named in `omitted`.

completeness.description: The completeness flag from the cited response, if it carried one

layer.description: Which layer the figure came from: dcpi | grid_analysis | facility_inventory | physical_infrastructure | deals | other. Decides the licence line; omit and you get the scoped statement rather than a grant.
